<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="abyssal-lords" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Abyssal Lords</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line">[https://runescape.wiki/w/Abyssal_lord <nowiki>Abyssal lords</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107327126904842.png?v=1" alt="abyssallord" title="abyssallord" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are the best abyssal creatures task for both experience and gold. They are mainly killed for Slayer </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> tasks, the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Slayer_collection_log#Senntisten <nowiki>Senntisten collection log</nowiki>]<nowiki>, combat </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896050370281523.png?v=1" alt="combat" title="combat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1" alt="invention" title="invention" kind="icon" /><nowiki> item experience, profit, and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1123586941057769552.png?v=1" alt="eliteclue" title="eliteclue" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643215216934518815.png?v=1" alt="trisk" title="trisk" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Abyssal lords tasks may be assigned by Mandrith.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Abyssal demons tasks may be assigned by Mandrith, Laniakea, Morvran, Kuradal, Duradel, Sumona, and The Raptor.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Demon cluster tasks may be assigned by Laniakea, and The Raptor.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Laniakea assigns almost twice as many.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ For both abyssal demons and demon cluster tasks, each </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107327126904842.png?v=1" alt="abyssallord" title="abyssallord" kind="icon" /><nowiki> counts as 5 kills.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="stats"><nowiki>Stats</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> level: 115 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107327126904842.png?v=1" alt="abyssallord" title="abyssallord" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per kill: 8,235 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107327126904842.png?v=1" alt="abyssallord" title="abyssallord" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~450 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, ~398 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, ~240 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• ~884 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (Wilderness abyssal lords and beasts)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ ~45% </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107327126904842.png?v=1" alt="abyssallord" title="abyssallord" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / ~55% </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107328964014100.png?v=1" alt="abyssalbeast" title="abyssalbeast" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per hour: ~3.71M </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, ~3.28M </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, ~1.98M </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• ~3.98m </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (Wilderness abyssal lords and beasts)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="location-and-how-to-get-there"><ins><nowiki>Location and How to Get there</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Abyssal lords can be fought in the Wilderness, the Senntisten Asylum, or the Sunken Pyramid.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Level 47 Wilderness</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/AL2LhIQoXZ.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ Use a </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1009419838764109834.png?v=1" alt="wildernesssword" title="wildernesssword" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and teleport to the Wilderness herb patch.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Position yourself on the westernmost corner of the rock and walk 2 tiles north and 1 tile west.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Place </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1" alt="cannon" title="cannon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> 1 tile west of the bottom skeleton.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If using an alt, position yourself as shown </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/nmGp4fMne5.png <nowiki>here</nowiki>]<nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Abyssal lords and beasts can be fought simultaneously at this location.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Do </nowiki><strong><nowiki>not</nowiki></strong><nowiki> use Necromancy </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> at this location.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Senntisten Asylum</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/wogijlVST4.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ Use a </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870326852361789501.png?v=1" alt="pontifexshadowring" title="pontifexshadowring" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and teleport to Senntisten, then run north-east towards the asylum elevator.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Once inside run to the final room, a </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Gate_key <nowiki>gate key</nowiki>]<nowiki> unlocks a shortcut.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Sunken Pyramid</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/mGGioEKQkA.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ Use a </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1097517249499254875.png?v=1" alt="slayercodex" title="slayercodex" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and teleport to the Sunken Pyramid.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Relocating your house to Menaphos and using a teleport to house tablet also works.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Place 5 abyssal lords in the small room, and position yourself 7 tiles south of the northern statue.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="method-afk-all-styles"><ins><nowiki>Method: AFK (all styles)</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Before loading your </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1" alt="cannon" title="cannon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and starting the session, check the following:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>General notes</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ensure </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1" alt="elderovl" title="elderovl" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1" alt="weppoison" title="weppoison" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1" alt="aggressionpotion" title="aggressionpotion" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are active at all times.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1" alt="aggressionpotion" title="aggressionpotion" kind="icon" /><nowiki> only needed in the Sunken Pyramid.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Sustain </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975765831248130079.png?v=1" alt="demonhornnecklace" title="demonhornnecklace" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023152065431744542.png?v=1" alt="ectoplasmator" title="ectoplasmator" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1" alt="powderofpenance" title="powderofpenance" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Melee</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1" alt="deflectmage" title="deflectmage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936606347280.png?v=1" alt="turmoil" title="turmoil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159416557573.png?v=1" alt="malevolence" title="malevolence" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Upkeep </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069423047442573.png?v=1" alt="vampyrismaspect" title="vampyrismaspect" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ensure that </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201294262009874.png?v=1" alt="vampscrim" title="vampscrim" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is active.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Magic</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1" alt="torment" title="torment" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158468907008.png?v=1" alt="affliction" title="affliction" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Autocast </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090745950258.png?v=1" alt="exsanguinate" title="exsanguinate" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and upkeep </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090453135382.png?v=1" alt="animatedead" title="animatedead" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ensure that </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417822188437569.png?v=1" alt="scriptureofamascut" title="scriptureofamascut" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is active.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Equilibrium 4 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088589627505.png?v=1" alt="eq4" title="eq4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> &gt; Biting 4 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087809617931.png?v=1" alt="biting4" title="biting4" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
